title: Pre-auth, CSRF and gate filters decide on the decoded, normalised application path (the one the container and Spring Security route on), failing closed on a path that cannot be normalised

criteria.given: the saiku-web filters that decide whether a request belongs to a protected surface (CSRF matcher, demo gate, embed, share, OAuth bearer, SCIM, SPA fallback)
criteria.then: none of them reads the raw, percent-encoded request URI: getRequestURI() is only used by the audit logger and by the shared RequestPaths helper
it decodes percent-encoding, strips ;path-parameters, drops '.' segments, collapses '//' and rejects '..', encoded slashes, backslashes and NUL (returning null so callers fail closed)

criteria.given: the regression tests for the helper and for the CSRF matcher and demo gate
criteria.then: they exist and cover the percent-encoded /%72est prefix
